```{r}
collisions_file_path <- "https://data.dft.gov.uk/road-accidents-safety-data/dft-road-casualty-statistics-collision-last-5-years.csv"
casualties_file_path <- "https://data.dft.gov.uk/road-accidents-safety-data/dft-road-casualty-statistics-casualty-last-5-years.csv"
vehicles_file_path <- "https://data.dft.gov.uk/road-accidents-safety-data/dft-road-casualty-statistics-vehicle-last-5-years.csv"

# download the data files from the specified URLs
if (0 == 1) {
  download.file(collisions_file_path, "data/collisions.csv")
  download.file(casualties_file_path, "data/casualties.csv")
  download.file(vehicles_file_path, "data/vehicles.csv")
}
```

```{r}
setwd("CD705-R/Research/Road_Safety")
collisions_df <- data.frame(read.csv("data/collisions.csv"))
casualties_df <- data.frame(read.csv("data/casualties.csv"))
vehicles_df <- data.frame(read.csv("data/vehicles.csv"))
print(getwd())
```
```{r}
speed_limits <- collisions_df$speed_limit
speed_limits <- na.omit(speed_limits)
plot(speed_limits, main="Speed Limits of Collisions", xlab="Speed Limit (mph)", ylab="Number of Collisions")
```
